  1827→            index with an additional level indicating the multiple
  1828→            geometries: a new zero-based index for each single part geometry
  1829→            per multi-part geometry).

  1833→        GeoDataFrame

  1835→            as a separate entry in the geodataframe.

  1841→        >>> d = {
  1842→        ...     "col1": ["name1", "name2"],
  1843→        ...     "geometry": [
  1844→        ...         MultiPoint([(1, 2), (3, 4)]),
  1845→        ...         MultiPoint([(2, 1), (0, 0)]),
  1846→        ...     ],
  1847→        ... }
  1848→        >>> gdf = geopandas.GeoDataFrame(d, crs=4326)
  1849→        >>> gdf
  1850→            col1               geometry
  1851→        0  name1  MULTIPOINT ((1 2), (3 4))
  1852→        1  name2  MULTIPOINT ((2 1), (0 0))
  1853→
  1854→        >>> exploded = gdf.explode(index_parts=True)
  1855→        >>> exploded
  1856→              col1     geometry
  1857→        0 0  name1  POINT (1 2)
  1858→          1  name1  POINT (3 4)
  1859→        1 0  name2  POINT (2 1)
  1860→          1  name2  POINT (0 0)
  1861→
  1862→        >>> exploded = gdf.explode(index_parts=False)
  1863→        >>> exploded
  1864→            col1     geometry
  1865→        0  name1  POINT (1 2)
  1866→        0  name1  POINT (3 4)
  1867→        1  name2  POINT (2 1)
  1868→        1  name2  POINT (0 0)
  1869→
  1870→        >>> exploded = gdf.explode(ignore_index=True)
  1871→        >>> exploded
  1872→            col1     geometry
  1873→        0  name1  POINT (1 2)
  1874→        1  name1  POINT (3 4)
  1875→        2  name2  POINT (2 1)
  1876→        3  name2  POINT (0 0)

  1898→                    FutureWarning,

    # create a simple GeoDataFrame
    gdf = GeoDataFrame(
        {

        }

    public_geo = gdf.to_geo(na="null", show_bbox=False, drop_id=False)

    gdf = GeoDataFrame(

            "geometry": [Point(1, 2), Point(2, 1)],
        }
    )

    assert geo["type"] == "FeatureCollection"
    assert "features" in geo
    assert len(geo["features"]) == 2

    assert "bbox" in geo
    assert isinstance(geo["bbox"], tuple)
    for feat in geo["features"]:
